current.text: Experts expect him to start for Memphis. Josh is certain he starts, and Joe's projected starting five has him at guard next to Ty Jerome.
Experts expect more minutes and more usage in his second season. Projections run from about 29 minutes to over 30 minutes a night.
Memphis runs an 11-man rotation, and Joe expects only Cameron Boozer and Coward to top 30 minutes.
Experts pick him as one of the bigger breakout players this season and expect a second-year jump.
Ja Morant has been traded to Portland, and Memphis has no real replacement at point guard.
Morant's exit leaves a big opening and little usage competition in Memphis, with Boozer seen as a main usage option.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace, which lifts counting stats.
Josh values him at about 6 USD in an auction.

durable.text: He is a strong defender and a rebounding wing. He is a third-option scorer who knocks down open shots.
He rebounds well for a guard or forward.
He has been poor at getting steals and blocks despite his defensive reputation.
One expert sees a good archetype but an older player who has not yet shown he can raise his usage or volume.

note: Coward is a cheap breakout bet. Josh values him at about 6 USD, close to his 6.4 USD Yahoo average cost, while ESPN has him at 1 USD and rank 124. He went undrafted in our league last season. His projected line (about 17 points, 6.8 rebounds, 84.7% FT) has no weak category, so he fits any build, though steals and turnovers are soft spots. Early in the season, check that he gets 29 to 30+ minutes in Iisalo's 11-man rotation and that his usage really rises toward Yahoo's projection of 14.2 shots per game, up from 10.5 last season.
